Golden Jubilee Foundation – Community Development

Instructions for scholarship applicants:-
  1. Applications received will be processed in two phases by the relevant Divisional Offices, namely PRELIMINARY AND FINAL.
  2. Applicants who pass the preliminary assessment will be contacted by the Divisional Offices to provide documents for final evaluation.
  3. Applicants must submit the requirement to the Divisional Offices within the specified time frame, failure to do so will result in your application not being considered for final evaluation.
  4. Each Divisional Office will select 80 candidates under General Scholarship and 40 candidates under Special Scholarship.

LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation was established on 20.10.2006, and registered with Charity Commissioner under Bombay Public Trust Act 1950 with the objective of promoting education, health, relief of poverty or distress and advancement of other objects of general public utility.

To achieve these objectives, the foundation works with human and capital resources received from LIC.

 

 

 

Category Number (Since Inception) Amount sanctioned in Rs.
ADVANCEMENT OF EDUCATION 419 83,47,97,826/-
MEDICAL RELIEF 446 1,78,17,57,602/-
OBJECTS OF GENERAL PUBLIC UTILITY 197 64,90,78,453/-
Total 1062 3,26,56,33,881/-

Projects range from scholarships, health initiatives, rural education programmes and providing infrastructural support in fields of education and health.
